title: Not getting owned
question: What would it actually take to break into this?
summary: Untrusted input reaching a parser that cannot tell data from code, a token left where a script can read it, and the handful of headers worth setting. Ends with issuing a token and gating a route on it.

steps.note: One shape underneath XSS and SQL injection both. Read it as one idea.
The expiry and the 401 are the workout. The password hash staying out of the response is the review.
